corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez relative pronoun at the end of line 5 is clearly 'እለ' (modifying 'ኅሩያኒሁ እለ ኅረየ እግዚአብሔር', 'His elect whom God chose'), which was misread as 'ዘአ-' wrapping into 'ኅረየ'.
Both visually on the page (shortened left leg of 4th-order ባ) and in canonical Ge'ez morphology, the word is 'ባሕቲቱ' ('alone').
